sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
Three Chain Combo: Includes Twisted Chain, Satellite Chain, and Veloré Snake Chain for multiple styling options.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 24K Gold Plated Finish: Each chain comes with a premium 24K gold plated shine for a rich and polished look.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Anti-Tarnish & Skin-Friendly: Designed for comfortable wear with an anti-tarnish finish to help maintain shine.

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 Layering-Friendly Design: Wear them solo, with pendants, or layer them together for an aesthetic golden neckline.

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
• Wear the Twisted Chain, Satellite Chain, and Veloré Snake Chain individually for a clean minimal look.
• Pair any chain with your favourite pendant to create a simple and stylish everyday neckline.
• Layer two or all three chains together when you want a more bold, aesthetic, and polished golden look.
• Style them with T-shirts, shirts, dresses, kurtis, co-ord sets, office outfits, festive wear, or party looks.
• Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain the 24K gold plated shine and anti-tarnish finish.
• After use, wipe gently with a soft dry cloth and store separately in a pouch or jewellery box to avoid scratches and tangling.

sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Some chains are made for one look. This combo is made for every mood, every outfit, and every styling moment.

The 24K Gold Plated Chain Combo brings together three everyday favourites — Twisted Chain, Satellite Chain, and Veloré Snake Chain — each designed with its own unique texture, shine, and personality.

The Twisted Chain (50 cm) adds a detailed textured look that catches light beautifully and gives your neckline a refined golden finish. The Satellite Chain (50 cm) brings a sleek minimal style with subtle centre detailing, making it perfect for clean everyday looks. The Veloré Snake Chain (45 cm) gives a smooth, fluid, and polished finish that feels effortlessly premium.

Crafted with a 24K gold plated finish, these chains add a rich golden shine while staying anti-tarnish and skin-friendly for comfortable regular styling. Wear them solo for a minimal look, pair them with pendants, or layer them together when you want a more styled and statement neckline.

Perfect for casual outfits, office looks, festive wear, brunch dates, party fits, or daily jewellery layering — this combo is made for people who love jewellery that is simple, stylish, premium, and easy to wear again and again.

Styling Tip: Wear one chain for a clean everyday look or layer all three together for a bold, aesthetic, and polished golden neckline.

 Crafted With
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 • Twisted Chain - Designed with a fine twisted pattern that adds texture, shine, and a refined golden look.

• Satellite Chain - Made with a sleek minimal chain design and subtle detailing for clean everyday styling.

• Veloré Snake Chain - Smooth and polished chain design that gives a premium, fluid, and elegant neckline finish.

• 24K Gold Plating - Adds a rich golden shine and luxurious finish to all three chains.

 

 

 
 <div class="

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Benefits
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 • 3 Styling Options

Twisted, Satellite, and Veloré Snake Chain give you three different looks in one combo.

• 24K Gold Plated Shine

The golden finish adds a rich, premium, and polished look to your neckline.

• Anti-Tarnish Finish

Helps maintain the chain’s shine and finish when cared for properly.

• Skin-Friendly Wear

Comfortable for regular styling and everyday jewellery use.

• Perfect For Layering

Wear one chain alone or layer all three together for a more stylish and complete look.

• Easy To Style

Pairs well with T-shirts, shirts, dresses, kurtis, co-ord sets, festive outfits, and party looks.

• Gift-Ready Combo

A thoughtful jewellery combo for anyone who loves minimal, stylish, and premium gold chains.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is included in this chain combo?

This combo includes 3 chains — Twisted Chain, Satellite Chain, and Veloré Snake Chain.

Q2. Are these chains 24K gold plated?

Yes, all three chains come with a 24K gold plated finish for a rich and premium golden shine.

Q3. Are these chains anti-tarnish?

Yes, these chains are designed with an anti-tarnish finish that helps maintain shine with proper care.

Q4. Are they skin-friendly?

Yes, the chains are made with a skin-friendly finish for comfortable regular styling.

Q5. Can I wear them daily?

Yes, these chains are lightweight, stylish, and perfect for daily wear, office looks, casual outfits, and festive styling.

Q6. Can I layer all three chains together?

Yes, you can wear them separately for a minimal look or layer them together for a bold and aesthetic golden neckline.

Q7. Can I use these chains with pendants?

Yes, you can pair them with your favourite pendants or wear them solo.
